Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Beyond the work, you will grow within a supportive Quant UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools to help you thrive.

As a part of the AI Enablement side of the ACE UX research team, you will execute on partnerships with AI Data and Research\-to\-Production (R2P). You will lead the development of next\-generation measurement frameworks, leveraging advanced statistical models and agentic AI workflows to analyze system logs at scale. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, and agentic developers, pioneer how we measure and optimize frictionless, high\-velocity developer workflows across the AI pipeline.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

* Design and implement agent\-assisted pipelines to parse, audit, and analyze massive\-scale system logs (e.g., telemetry, clickstream, operational logs) to accelerate insight generation.

San Francisco Public Utilities Commission (SFPUC)

**Our Mission:** To provide our customers with high quality, efficient, and reliable water, power, and wastewater services in a manner that values environmental and community interests and sustains the resources entrusted to our care.

The Customer Service Bureau (CSB) division operates the administration, customer accounts, field services, and business center sections. Services include processing new service installations, service renewals, billing and collections, managing customer inquiries, cashiering and payment processing, meter reading, and field investigations.


This bureau employs about 110 positions and operates on a $16 million annual budget. CSB is comprised of committed employees using the latest operational efficiencies to deliver complete customer satisfaction through effective customer service.

The 0922 Manager I \- Customer Contact Center Manager, under direction, administers and supervises the activities and personnel of one operating section of SFPUC Customer Services: Customer Contact Center, Billing, Collection, Retail Services, or Business and Systems Support.

* Plans, assigns, and inspects the work of subordinate staff, to ensure operational efficiency relating to water, wastewater, electric services and land leases and permits, as well as conformance with departmental policies, procedures, laws and regulations.
* Oversees the operations of a Customer Contact Center, Billing, Collection, Retail Services, or Business and Systems Support for effectiveness and efficiency, identifies, investigates, analyzes, and mitigates operational issues.
* Directs the preparation of complex financial, statistical and operational reports and records including customer bills, service records and collection accounts.
* Maintains effective communication with representatives from various City departments, contractors, banking officials and the general public in connection with departmental policies, rules and regulations.
* Oversees the preparation and maintenance of a wide variety of records, reports and documents consisting of the Bureau’s financial, statistical and operational information.  

Collaborates with managers and supervisors on Customer Information System (CIS) system development and implementation.
* Participates in hiring and staff development practices, establishes and maintains effective working relationships, conducts timely performance reviews.
* Coordinates section or division operations, including complex technical issues involving various types of accounts, new services, deposits, receipts, collections, disbursements and reporting activities with other areas or agencies.
* Oversees various complex customer information systems utilized in billing and collection of water and wastewater services, electric services, land leases and permits.


The 0922 Manager I \- Customer Contact Center Manager will perform other related duties as assigned.

 **Qualifications** **Education:** Possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university. **AND**

**Experience:** Five (5\) years of recent verifiable professional work experience performing customer service, billing, collections, or contact center functions within a water, wastewater/sewer, electric, or other public/municipal utility organization. **AND**

At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission\-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. With 70\+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

The Functional (Business) Analyst \- Expert / Knowledge Management Lead will lead process documentation, knowledge management, requirements analysis, and organizational knowledge\-transfer activities for FDA/CDER OCS Data Management and Data Quality (DMDQ) operations. The role will work across operational, data\-quality, and modernization workstreams to ensure business processes, SOPs, requirements, technical artifacts, lessons learned, and training materials remain current, usable, version controlled, and accessible to Government and contractor personnel.

  

**DUTIES**

  


* Lead and maintain the centralized DMDQ Knowledge Management Repository in FDA\-designated collaboration platforms, organizing SOPs, project and technical documentation, process maps, user guides, business and validation rules, lessons learned, training materials, and knowledge\-transfer artifacts.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business and operational requirements with OCS stakeholders, tool teams, service teams, data managers, and technical personnel; translate requirements into clear process, workflow, reporting, and modernization needs.
* Document and continuously improve business processes supporting study data acquisition, validation, loading, curation, data quality, governance, reporting, workflow automation, system integration, incident/change management, and operational support.
* Develop, review, and maintain SOPs and operating guides; ensure documentation is technically accurate, logically organized, version controlled, and updated as procedures, policies, business rules, or systems change.
* Plan and facilitate knowledge\-transfer, cross\-training, system walkthroughs, process demonstrations, lessons\-learned sessions, and Government training to reduce key\-person dependency and preserve continuity of operations.
* Support Task 3\.2 data\-quality reporting and Task 3\.4 modernization through requirements analysis, user stories/use cases, acceptance criteria, UAT coordination, process impact analysis, and traceability between business needs and implemented capabilities.
* Track documentation status, knowledge gaps, training needs, and process\-improvement opportunities; provide metrics and recommendations to the Project Manager and FDA stakeholders.

  


**EDUCATION**

  



Experience level, education, and qualifications consistent with the applicable RRS BPA Functional (Business) Analyst Expert labor category.

  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* Demonstrated experience leading business analysis, requirements elicitation, process mapping, SOP/document development, knowledge management, and stakeholder facilitation in complex technical or regulated environments.
* Ability to translate operational and technical information into clear, actionable documentation for business, scientific, and technical audiences.
* Experience with document repositories, version control, workflow/process documentation, requirements traceability, and quality review of deliverables.
* Strong written communication, facilitation, organization, and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a High\-Risk Public Trust or equivalent federal client access. This role supports sensitive federal programs and involves elevated access to systems and data.
* Position requires the current ability to obtain and maintain required access without interruption in alignment with long\-term program needs.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* Prior FDA/CDER, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical\-data, or Federal health experience; familiarity with study\-data workflows, data quality/governance, CDISC concepts, SharePoint, Jira or similar work\-management tools, Agile delivery, EPLC documentation, and modernization or transition activities.

jobs.description:
The VBC Care Navigator's primary job responsibility is to effectively guide and coordinate care for patients with complex healthcare needs. The Care Navigator will act as the first point of patient contact for incoming or outbound Kidneylink calls. Schedule calls with our interdisciplinary clinical team and gather and verify demographic information, utilize tools and critical thinking, and route calls as appropriate following standard operating procedures.  

Engagement:* Conduct welcome calls to introduce patients to the program and its benefits.
* Initiate outreach efforts to engage patients and build rapport.
* Schedule appointments and facilitate initial patient engagement.
* Patient Activation Measure (PAM) Screening:
* Administer PAM assessments to gauge patients' readiness for active self\-care.
* Utilize assessment results to tailor care plans accordingly.
* PHQ\-9 Screening and Escalation:
* Conduct PHQ\-9 screenings to assess patients for depression.
* Initiate the escalation pathway for patients with PHQ\-9 scores above 9\.
* Advanced Directives Screening:
* Assess patients' awareness and understanding of advanced directives.
* Offer education on advanced directives and assist with documentation.

  

IDT Scheduling:  

* Collaborate with the Interdisciplinary Team (IDT) to schedule patient appointments.
* Ensure timely coordination of care among team members.
* Demographic Information Verification:
* Verify and update patient demographic information to maintain accurate records.
* Panel Management and Appointment

  

Scheduling:  

* Manage a panel of patients, ensuring their appointments with Kidneylink (KL) are scheduled appropriately.
* Coordinate with patients to ensure adherence to their care plans.
* Medication Entry and Pharmacist Referrals:
* Enter medication information into the system for proper tracking.
* Refer patients to pharmacists for medication\-related queries and guidance.
* Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Assessment:
* Screen patients for social determinants of health, addressing potential barriers to care.

  

Care Coordination Tasks:  

* Receive care coordination tasks assigned by Registered Nurses (RNs).
* Implement care coordination plans and strategies as directed.
* Hospitalization Screening and TOC Workflow:
* Screen for hospitalizations, emergency room visits, and inpatient stays.
* Initiate Transitional Office Care (TOC) workflow for seamless post\-hospital care.
* External Continuity of Care:
* Monitor patients' external continuity of care, including PCP appointments and dialysis clinic visits.
* Ensure patients are linked to necessary follow\-up care.

  

EMR Documentation:  

* Document patient interactions and relevant information in the physician's Electronic Medical Record (EMR).
* Utilize tools such as CKCC flags to indicate critical patient information.
* TOC Follow\-Up Appointments:
* Facilitate follow\-up appointments after hospital visits through shared tools.
* Notify healthcare practices of required patient follow\-up.
* Issue Identification and Escalation:
* Identify emerging issues during patient interactions and escalate them to Registered Nurses for appropriate action.

  

Optimal Start (OS) Coordination:  

* Coordinate optimal starts such as access placement, ensuring seamless patient care.

  

Other:* Participates in team concepts and promote a team effort; performs duties in accordance with company policies and procedures.
* Regular and reliable attendance is required for the job.

jobs.title: Senior Management Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Significance, Inc is seeking a Senior Management Business Analyst to support an upcoming federal program (contingent upon award). This position will be remote.

The U.S. Department of Labor keeps its books in the New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS), an Oracle E\-Business Suite platform used by about 1,600 people to move roughly $70 billion a year. You will be the senior functional link between DOL accountants and the people who build and fix the system. You will own requirements, testing, and the hardest production problems in Federal Financials. When the general ledger does not tie out at year\-end, that lands with you.

Objective: keep NCFMS functionally correct and audit\-ready, so that DOL's accounting operations close on time and every configuration, interface, and enhancement change holds up under Treasury, OMB, GAO, and financial statement audit scrutiny.
### **Required Skills:**


Minimum 9 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or ERP business systems analyst supporting enterprise financial management systems. Federal financial systems experience strongly preferred within that total.  

* Minimum 5 of those 9 years hands\-on functional experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite Federal Financials in one or more of: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Sub Ledger Accounting, Budget Execution, Purchase Cards, and Oracle Projects.
* Functional business process analysis for a federal ERP system, spanning each aspect of both traditional and Agile SDLCs \- requirements through design, test, deployment, and post\-production support.
* Demonstrated experience eliciting, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements; authoring functional design documents, use cases, and process flows; maintaining requirements traceability; and validating that requirements were correctly implemented.
* Test planning and execution: developing test scenarios, scripts, and traceability matrices; executing unit, system, integration, regression, and User Acceptance Testing; documenting results and driving defects to closure.
* Production support and complex issue resolution: triaging user\-reported issues, root\-cause analysis, researching transaction and posting\-logic errors, and coordinating resolution with technical, DBA, and security teams \- including Tier 2 and Tier 3 functional support.
* Authoring senior\-level analytical deliverables: analysis papers, analyses of alternatives, decision papers, and other project deliverables for Government review.
* Performing quality assurance and oversight of functional work products \- peer review of requirements, design, and test artifacts.
* Working knowledge of federal financial management compliance drivers: U.S. Standard General Ledger (USSGL), Treasury Financial Manual, FASAB standards, OMB circulars, GAO guidance, budget execution and funds control, and the Anti\-Deficiency Act.
* Experience with structured change control and Change Control Board processes.
* Experience managing assigned work in an industry\-standard issue and backlog management tool
* Ability to perform with limited supervision and to provide direction, review, or mentoring to less senior analysts
### **Desired Skills:**

* Prior experience supporting federal Core Financial System with Oracle Federal Financials at a CFO Act agency
* Experience with end\-to\-end business processes: Procure\-to\-Pay, Bill\-to\-Collect, Acquire\-to\-Dispose, Request\-to\-Procure, Budget Execution, Purchase Cards, Grants Management, Unemployment Trust Fund, Travel Management, General Ledger Integrity, and Working Capital Fund cost allocation using Oracle Projects.
* Experience with Treasury G\-Invoicing, including 7600A Interagency Agreements and 7600B Orders; GTAS; DATA Act reporting; and the Treasury Report on Receivables.
* Experience with applications and interfaces such as: Tungsten MarkView / Capture invoice imaging and workflow, Oracle Analytics Server reporting, Invoice Processing Platform, SAM vendor data, ETS2 travel, HHS GrantSolutions, NFC payroll, the AMS real\-time requisition and award interface, and the Citibank Purchase Card interface.
* Experience supporting federal financial statement audits — researching transactions, preparing audit responses and supporting documentation, and remediating findings through corrective action plans.
* Experience writing knowledge\-base articles, standard operating procedures, quick reference guides, and user job aids.
* Experience as a task lead or supervising junior functional analysts on a federal ERP O\&M engagement.

jobs.title: Health Coach - Remote
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech\-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data\-driven AI insights, evidence\-based resources, and comprehensive platform – including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, health information management, and more – Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well\-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value\-based care at scale. To learn more, visit www.sharecare.com.


Health Coaches operate in a structured, high\-engagement outreach model utilizing an automated dialer system to connect with members throughout the day. Coaches conduct back\-to\-back coaching conversations, providing education, support, and motivation to help members progress toward their health goals while following established workflows and documentation standards.  

  

**Job Summary:**

**Start Date:** Monday, October 26th, 2026

**Shift:** Monday \- Friday: Must be open to any shift between the hours of 10:30am – 9:00pm CST.


It is required to work every fourth Saturday from 8:00am\-4:30pm CST

**Training:** Training will be a duration of 6 weeks from 8am – 4:30pm CST

* ***Due to the structured training schedule, new hires are unable to miss any days of training.***

**Compensation:** Hourly Rate: $21\.50 or $25 including certification through NBC\-HWC or CHES only


The Health Coach is part of a multi\-disciplinary team that is responsible for improving both the individual health and wellness of program participants and the overall health status of a client's population. The Health Coach is an integral part of an overall client specific Health and Care Support Team that engages and supports members with improving lifestyles and behaviors that put them "at risk" of developing chronic or disease conditions. The Health Coach looks to be a positive change agent in helping members alter behaviors that lead to better health and reduction / elimination of identified risk factors. A Health Coach is supervised by an Operations Coach Manager.

**Essential Job Functions:**


Participating in the following types of telephonic calls:

* Engagement (inbound and outbound)\- contacting eligible participants to inform them of the program offering and enroll them in the program
* Coaching (inbound and outbound)\- providing individualized behavior change coaching to reduce or eliminate high risk behaviors and encourage adoption of habits that are conducive to a higher quality of life
* Chase (outbound)\- reaching out to members who are enrolled in coaching, but do not have a scheduled call
* Coordinate delivery of services and care with other members of a multi\-disciplinary care team, including nurses, pharmacists and external vendors.
* Support operational aspects of the assigned area to meet the organization's customer requirements, which can include multiple customers.
* Adhere to a schedule and caseload to support success and connectivity of member interaction.
* Caseloads may be a 1:1 model or team based. This is determined by the business/client need.
* Participate in daily and monthly meetings for updates and to present findings and insight
* Note and track the members' progress and efficacy of program

**Specific Skills/ Attributes:**

* Effective interpersonal and communication skills required
* Understand directions and communicate/respond to inquiries
* Enthusiastically inspires members to change behaviors and to see possibilities
* Ability to learn to coach effectively using motivational interviewing
* Flexibility to work any shift (typically an evening shift) or change shifts based on business needs. This also includes availability to work rotating Saturdays

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in health\-related field required (i.e., Psychology, Nutrition, Exercise Science, etc.) In specific cases, NBHWC certification might substitute for the “health \-related” part of the completed 4\-year degree
* 1 \-2 years of related experience required; experience in a customer service role preferred
* Experience with benchmarks and contact center metrics preferred, including adherence to schedule
* Proficiency in computer data entry and Microsoft Office
* Ability to coordinate telephonic communication with program participants while simultaneously navigating software platform and entering data, for extended periods of time
* Knowledge ability to quickly learn information around lifestyle related topics such as: smoking cessation, weight management, nutrition, exercise, stress reduction and sleep desired

jobs.title: Certified Health Coach - Remote
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech\-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data\-driven AI insights, evidence\-based resources, and comprehensive platform – including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, health information management, and more – Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well\-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value\-based care at scale. To learn more, visit www.sharecare.com.


Health Coaches operate in a structured, high\-engagement outreach model utilizing an automated dialer system to connect with members throughout the day. Coaches conduct back\-to\-back coaching conversations, providing education, support, and motivation to help members progress toward their health goals while following established workflows and documentation standards.

**Job Summary:**

**Start Date:** Monday, October 26th, 2026

**Shift:** Monday \- Friday: Must be open to any shift between the hours of 10:30am – 9:00pm CST.


It is required to work every fourth Saturday from 8:00am\-4:30pm CST

**Training:** Training will be a duration of 6 weeks from 8am – 4:30pm CST

* ***Due to the structured training schedule, new hires are unable to miss any days of training.***

**Compensation:** Hourly Rate: $21\.50 or $25 including certification through NBC\-HWC or CHES only


The Certified Health Coach is part of a multi\-disciplinary team that is responsible for improving both the individual health and wellness of program participants and the overall health status of a client's population. The Certified Health Coach is an integral part of an overall client specific Health and Care Support Team that engages and supports members with improving lifestyles and behaviors that put them "at risk" of developing chronic or disease conditions. The Certified Health Coach looks to be a positive change agent in helping members alter behaviors that lead to better health and reduction / elimination of identified risk factors. A Certified Health Coach is supervised by a Manager Coaching Operations.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Participating in the following types of telephonic calls:
* Engagement (inbound and outbound)\- contacting eligible participants to inform them of the program offering and enroll them in the program
* Coaching (inbound and outbound)\- providing individualized behavior change coaching to reduce or eliminate high risk behaviors and encourage adoption of habits that are conducive to a higher quality of life
* Chase (outbound)\- reaching out to members who are enrolled in coaching, but do not have a scheduled call
* Coordinate delivery of services and care with other members of a multi\-disciplinary care team, including nurses and external vendors.
* Support operational aspects of the assigned area to meet the organization's customer requirements, which can include multiple customers.
* Adhere to a schedule and caseload to support success and connectivity of member interaction.
* Caseloads may be a 1:1 model or team based. This is determined by the business/client need.
* Participate in daily and monthly meetings for updates and to present findings and insight
* Note and track the members' progress and efficacy of program

**Specific Skills/ Attributes:**

* Effective interpersonal and communication skills required
* Understand directions and communicate/respond to inquiries
* Enthusiastically inspires members to change behaviors and to see possibilities
* Ability to coach effectively using motivational interviewing
* Ability to learn and effectively utilize documentation software to record interactions with members and to communicate directly with them via chat
* Attention to detail when documenting interactions with participants
* Flexibility to work any shift (typically an evening shift) or change shifts based on business needs. This also includes availability to work rotating Saturdays

**Qualifications:**

* Completed training from a NBHWC certified training program required
* Active board certification in Wellness Coaching from NBHWC a plus
* Bachelor's degree in health\-related field required (i.e., Psychology, Nutrition, Exercise Science, etc.)
* Experience with using chat to deliver coaching sessions a plus
* Experience with benchmarks and contact center metrics preferred, including adherence to schedule
* Proficiency in computer data entry and Microsoft Office
* Ability to coordinate telephonic communication with program participants while simultaneously navigating software platform and entering data, for extended periods of time
* Knowledge ability to quickly learn information around lifestyle related topics such as: smoking cessation, weight management, nutrition, exercise, stress reduction and sleep desired
* Ability to work independently and prioritize a moderate workload with minimal supervision
* Adaptability to schedule changes on an as\-need basis
* Ability to multitask with members and operationally with managers and support staff
* Hard\-wired internet connection is necessary as WIFI is not permitted


Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E\-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law.

jobs.title: Operations Associate, Beckett
jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  

  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  

  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  

  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.  



  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.  



  

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible coins, trading cards, Funko Pops!, video games, event tickets, autographs, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, WATA, Card Ladder, SGC, Beckett, and the Long Beach Expo collectibles trade show. Since our founding in 1986, we have authenticated and graded millions of items. We employ more than 1,700 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana and offices in Florida, Jersey City, Hong Kong, Mexico, Paris, Shanghai, and Tokyo.


We’re looking for an Operations Associate for our Beckett team to handle various processes across our trading card grading operations: order receiving, imaging, encapsulation, research \& ID, and quality control. This is an exciting opportunity to be one of our first employees in a brand new office space and join a team that is growing quickly. **You’ll report to the Operations Supervisor and work from our newest office in the Southwest Portland, OR suburbs Monday through Friday (exact shift time TBD, but will likely start between 6\-9am).** Experience as a collector or knowledge of trading cards in general is not required, but for those passionate about the hobby, this is a great opportunity to build a career in trading cards.


**What You’ll Do:**

* Match, count, and check items.
* Enter item information into the database and print stickers containing order details.
* Work with the Customer Service and Problem Orders departments to resolve problems.
* Work with other cross\-functional teams on special projects and/or deals.
* Research cards utilizing checklists from manufacturers and enter the information into our database
* Encapsulate and seal cards.
* Inspect assembled parts and product for defects and deviations.
* Verify information such as submission form details, product quantity, identification stickers, and labels.
* Verify order correctness and completeness.
* Take high resolution photos of each card in an order as they are completed, utilizing a mounted camera and computer program.
* Package orders in mailing box containers, seal with tape and attach outside labels.
* Process shipping for specified return carrier and close order.
* Safely handle and account for valuable merchandise, ensuring its security and proper handling throughout all process stages.

**Who You Are:**

* You have the ability to work in a team environment.
* You can prioritize all tasks and work in a fast\-paced work environment.
* You are a team player who is willing and able to work well with others.
* You are professional in your behavior, interact respectfully with coworkers, and work well under pressure in fast\-paced environments.
* You produce high quality, accurate work and demonstrate thoroughness in your work.
* You are dependable and able to follow instructions and respond to directions from your supervisor(s).
* You have experience working with computers e.g. Gmail, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.
* You have great communication skills.
* You can make independent and knowledgeable decisions relating to the assigned task(s).
* You have good hand\-eye coordination and are comfortable with physical labor.
* Previous experience in a warehouse or manufacturing environment is a plus.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Bending and Twisting: Bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, and squatting.
* Computer Use: Typing, mouse work, and sitting and looking at a computer potentially for long periods of time.
* Hand Use: Regular hand use for various tasks.
* Hearing Requirements: Ability to hear alarms, signals, and verbal instructions.
* Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift, carry, and move materials up 50 lbs.
* Receiving and Inspecting Submissions: Ability to receive, and in some departments inspect, submissions. Ability to use a sharp blade and retrieve submissions from packaging.
* Sitting or Standing: Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time.

jobs.title: Sr. Account Manager, Industrial Water, NA
jobs.description:
**Location:**  

Remote, US
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
  

**Location Details:**  

**Title:** Sr. Account Manager, Industrial Water, NA
  
  

SR. ACCOUNT MANAGER, INDUSTRY NA
  
  

Kemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water\-intensive industries. For more than 100 years, our chemistry has advanced human progress and quality of life. We call it chemistry with a purpose, better every day. At Kemira, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work culture that empowers our employees to thrive and make a difference. Learn more about Kemira at kemira.com/careers.
  
  

We are now looking for an Sr. Account Manager, Industry NA to join our Water Solutions business unit. This role is ideal for a commercially driven sales professional with a proven record of growing industrial chemical sales, managing high\-value customer portfolios, and building long\-term customer relationships that support sustainable business growth.
  
  

Water Solutions offers a wide range of innovative solutions to optimize all stages of the water treatment process while safely achieving water quality targets and meeting constantly tightening regulations. The business serves both municipal and industrial customers globally, with strong growth ambitions in the North American industrial market.
  
  

This position can be remote, but proximity to a major airport is a plus.
  
  

**In this role, you will be responsible for:**  

Driving profitable growth across assigned industrial accounts, including identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities.
  
Managing and expanding a significant sales portfolio, with preferred experience supporting approximately $25 million or more in annual sales revenue.
  
Building strong direct customer relationships while also managing and developing indirect sales channels, including distributors and resellers.
  
Demonstrating a strong hunting mindset to pursue new opportunities, while also farming and protecting existing business through long\-term customer partnerships.
  
Providing technical and commercial support to customers by understanding their needs and positioning Kemira’s industrial water treatment and chemical solutions effectively.
  
Collaborating with internal teams, including R\&D, product management, supply chain, and customer service, to ensure customer satisfaction and business continuity.
  
Preparing and delivering compelling presentations, proposals, and business reviews to customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  

**What you’ll bring to the team:**  

Proven success growing sales in industrial chemicals, water treatment, or a closely related technical B2B environment.
  
Demonstrated ability to develop new business and expand existing accounts through both direct sales and indirect channel strategies.
  
Experience managing complex, high\-value customer relationships and delivering measurable revenue growth.
  
Strong commercial discipline, negotiation skills, and ability to convert customer needs into value\-based solutions.
  
Technical curiosity and credibility with the ability to partner with customers on industrial process, water treatment, or chemical application challenges.
  
Ability to work independently, prioritize opportunities, and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.
  
**A growth\-oriented mindset aligned with Kemira Principles:** Focus on Growth, Deliver Value, and Collaborate to Succeed.
  
A technical background in coagulants, flocculants, defoamers and dispersants would be a plus.
  
  

**What you can expect from us:**  

Challenging, interesting, and varied work in a global company with strong growth ambitions in industrial water treatment.
  
**A collaborative culture based on Kemira Principles:** Focus on Growth, Collaborate to Succeed, and Deliver Value.
  
The opportunity to make a direct impact by helping customers improve water\-intensive operations through sustainable chemistry.
  
An attractive salary, benefits package, and discretionary bonus scheme.
  
The starting base salary range for this role is between $120,000 to $140,000 per year. Salary ranges may vary depending on location and local market conditions. The actual starting salary will be determined by various factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, skills and competencies, qualifications, and wider business and organizational needs.
  
  

Ready to create better every day? Join Kemira!
  
  

Please apply with a CV at kemira.com/careers.
  
  

To ensure a smooth recruitment process, we kindly ask candidates to submit their applications via our recruitment system at kemira.com/careers. Applications sent by email cannot be considered.
  
  

We are leading the way to sustained fair pay in the workplace. As a Fair Pay Certified company, we are taking action to enable ongoing equal pay for equal work. This certification demonstrates our commitment to using trusted and transparent methodologies to analyze pay equity. We are proud to share this achievement as part of our dedication to a fair and equitable workplace for everyone.
  
  

Kemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water\-intensive industries. We operate globally and serve a wide range of customers, including municipal and industrial water treatment companies and the fiber industry. Our solutions and services help secure clean water for millions of people every day and support our customers in advancing circularity and responsible resource use throughout their value chains. In 2025, Kemira reported annual revenue of EUR 2\.8 billion with a global team of 4,911 colleagues. Kemira is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki. www.kemira.com

Founded in 1947 and headquartered in Schofield, Wisconsin, Wausau Supply Company has a history of providing top\-quality building materials to authorized retailers across the United States. As a proud 100% employee\-owned company, we are dedicated to not only serving our customers but also ensuring that our employees have a direct stake in our success. We distribute building materials from the industry’s leading manufacturers to authorized retailers from the western Rocky Mountains to the east coast. In addition to our distribution capabilities, Wausau Supply Company is known for its high\-quality manufactured brands, including Diamond Kote Siding System, Waudena, ChamClad and Taylor Entrance Systems. These brands reflect our commitment to innovation, safety, service and integrity. Our territory continues to expand as we continuously strive to meet the demands of our customers with nineteen distribution centers and five fabrication and finishing facilities across the United States.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager - National Service Providers
jobs.description:
VSG is looking for an experienced **Strategic National Accounts Manager** to help grow our business with the largest national service providers across North America. This isn't a traditional account management role. We're looking for someone who understands how large service organizations operate—someone who knows how to navigate complex organizations, build relationships at multiple levels, uncover new opportunities, develop long\-term growth strategies across multiple business units and operating regions, and a strong knowledge of the Arbor Industry.

The ideal candidate is:

* Experienced managing large strategic or national accounts
* Comfortable navigating complex organizations with multiple stakeholders
* Skilled at building executive relationships while also engaging field operations and safety teams
* A self\-starter who proactively identifies opportunities rather than simply responding to customer requests
* Motivated, competitive, and driven by results
* Passionate about helping customers improve safety, productivity, and operational performance
* Familiar with the Arbor Industry

**Base Salary up to $100K with Bonus eligibility**

At Vertical Supply Group, you'll represent a portfolio of industry\-leading brands across rope, rigging, climbing, lifting, fall protection, and work\-at\-height solutions while helping some of North America's largest contractors standardize equipment, improve worker safety, and solve complex operational challenges. This is an opportunity to build strategic partnerships—not simply manage accounts.

**What You'll Do**

Success in this role is measured by your ability to grow strategic relationships, uncover new opportunities, expand product adoption, and increase revenue across your assigned national accounts.

You'll be responsible for:

* Developing and executing strategic account plans for assigned National Service Provider customers.
* Building relationships with executive leadership, operations, safety, procurement, fleet, training, and regional management teams.
* Identifying new opportunities to expand VSG's portfolio across multiple business units, regions, and operating divisions.
* Increasing share of wallet through cross\-selling and introducing new products and solutions.
* Leading business reviews and executive planning meetings with key customers.
* Coordinating internally across sales, customer service, operations, marketing, and product management to ensure exceptional customer support.
* Working alongside distributor partners and internal sales teams to maximize growth opportunities.
* Conducting product demonstrations, new product introductions, and customer training.
* Developing three\-year strategic growth plans for each assigned account.
* Maintaining a disciplined opportunity pipeline while accurately forecasting revenue.
* Providing Voice of Customer (VOC), competitive intelligence, and market feedback that influence future product development.
* Representing Vertical Supply Group at customer events, trade shows, and industry conferences.

**What Success Looks Like**

Successful candidates will:

* Become trusted advisors to their largest customers.
* Expand relationships beyond purchasing into operations, safety, and executive leadership.
* Increase product penetration across multiple VSG brands.
* Identify and close new enterprise\-wide opportunities.
* Grow revenue and share of wallet year over year.
* Build multi\-year strategic partnerships that create sustainable growth.
* Deliver measurable business results while providing outstanding customer experience.

**Qualifications**

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with exceptional relationship\-building skills.

Preferred qualifications include:

* Five or more years of successful experience managing large national or strategic accounts.
* Proven ability to grow enterprise\-level customer relationships.
* Experience selling industrial safety, climbing, rope, rigging, lifting, fall protection, PPE, or related products preferred.
* Strong executive communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Demonstrated success identifying and developing new business opportunities within existing customers.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills with disciplined pipeline and account management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; CRM and ERP experience preferred (NetSuite experience is a plus).
* Ability to travel approximately 50% throughout North America.
* Located near a major airport preferred.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish (fluent in speaking and reading) is a plus but not required.

Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Employee discount
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst | Oracle EPM Implementation
jobs.description:
**Senior Business Analyst \| Oracle EPM Implementation**


**Location:** South Bend, IN (90% Remote, 10% Travel onsite)



**Job Type:** 6\-mo\-contract


* This represents the potential salary range for this position depending on education level, years of experience and/or certifications in addition to other position specific requirements which may impact salary


**Position Overview:**
======================


We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with recent, hands\-on Oracle EPM implementation experience to support a client currently progressing through an Oracle implementation and moving into the next phase of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and reporting.


This role will sit at the intersection of business stakeholders, functional teams, implementation partners, and technology teams. The ideal candidate is a strong functional Business Analyst who can bring structure to an evolving implementation by leading requirements discovery, defining scope, documenting future\-state processes, and translating business needs into clear functional requirements. This is more of a BA role than a PM role. The client needs someone who can step into the functional side of the implementation, ask the right questions, organize complex needs, and help drive Oracle EPM and reporting work forward.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* Lead requirements gathering sessions with Finance, HR, business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners.


* Define and document business, functional, and reporting requirements for Oracle EPM.


* Help establish and refine project scope, priorities, dependencies, and functional workstreams.


* Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.


* Develop current\-state and future\-state process flows.


* Support the design and implementation of Oracle EPM functionality and reporting.


* Partner with business users to define reporting, forecasting, planning, budgeting, and performance\-management needs.


* Identify gaps between current processes and Oracle EPM capabilities.


* Work closely with implementation consultants and technical teams to ensure requirements are correctly translated into system configuration and solutions.


* Support testing strategy, test scenarios, UAT, defect resolution, and implementation readiness.


* Assist with data validation, reporting validation, integrations, and business process alignment.


* Facilitate stakeholder meetings and help drive decisions when requirements or scope are unclear.


* Support change management, user readiness, documentation, and go\-live activities.


* Provide light project coordination where needed, while remaining primarily focused on functional Business Analysis.


**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* 7\+ years of Business Analysis, Business Systems Analysis, or equivalent functional systems experience.


* Hands\-on Oracle EPM implementation experience within the last 5 years.


* Experience participating in an Oracle EPM implementation from requirements and scoping through testing and go\-live.


* Strong experience with requirements elicitation, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and functional discovery.


* Demonstrated ability to define and document project scope.


* Experience creating BRDs, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and process maps.


* Strong experience supporting system testing and UAT.


* Experience working directly with Finance and/or HR stakeholders.


* Strong functional understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, planning, or enterprise performance management.


* Ability to translate business needs into functional requirements for implementation teams.


* Experience working with implementation partners, vendors, consultants, and internal technical teams.


* Strong communication and facilitation skills.


* Oracle EPM Experience


* Candidates should have recent implementation experience with one or more Oracle EPM technologies, such as:
